answer: Cross-substrate attestation: each identity must be attested by two independent operators whose own records span different network neighborhoods, like a reef grown from separate currents. A clone cluster cannot supply that diversity, so every additional identity forces the attacker to acquire and maintain genuinely disjoint infrastructure, verified by periodic traversal. Attestation validity refreshes on a fixed cadence, a sonnet of signed checks each cycle. Each failed inlet of fresh operators voids the clone and forfeits its accumulated work.
